scope: Executable paths surfaced by bounded repository searches for landing, helipad, nearest, matched_facility_id, hangar, apron, and proximity semantics. Search discovery is not represented as universal source-tree exhaustion.

findings.finding: Distance-derived endpoint candidates were allowed to overwrite origin_code/destination_code even though endpoint_matcher labels them needs_review and explicitly says they are not confirmed takeoff/landing events.
findings.remediation: Require review_status=promoted, identity_state=CERTIFIED, and association_state stronger than DISCOVERY_ONLY before route mutation.

findings.finding: Nearest-airport candidates were already review-gated in prose but lacked machine-readable identity/association states.
findings.remediation: Emit identity_state=CANDIDATE_NOT_IDENTITY and association_state=DISCOVERY_ONLY for every distance-band match.

findings.finding: Proximity ranking included facility-class boosts but returned no explicit machine-readable statement that results are discovery-only.
findings.remediation: Stamp every FootprintMatch with evidence_role=DISCOVERY_ONLY and identity_state=CANDIDATE_NOT_IDENTITY.

findings.finding: Nearest-only relation already maps to DISCOVERY_ONLY and helicopter presence cannot promote a helipad.
findings.remediation: Retain unchanged; add geometry-adjudication companion contract.

findings.finding: Nearest, proximity, search rank, same category and unbound labels are discovery signals and cannot bind identity.

Endpoint events are exported as standalone event entities and include matched_facility_id, but the exporter does not create a facility-identity relationship from that field. Candidate identity/association state propagation is not yet explicit in the canonical entity payload.
findings.remediation: Treat matched_facility_id as event evidence only; future contract revision should project identity_state and association_state as explicit fields.

regression_gates: only explicitly promoted certified endpoint may update route
proximity result remains CANDIDATE_NOT_IDENTITY even at score 1.0
authoritative airport diagram is not certified machine geometry
name/address/proximity-only evidence never certifies facility identity
certification: PROVISIONAL_BOUNDED_AUDIT; one material auto-promotion path found and patched; universal executable-source exhaustion not claimed
